steps: Allotropy is the property of an element to exist in two or more different forms in the same physical state.
These different forms are called allotropes and have different physical properties but similar chemical properties.
Carbon exists in crystalline forms, such as diamond and graphite, and in an amorphous form, such as coal.
In diamond, each carbon atom is covalently bonded to four other carbon atoms in a rigid three-dimensional structure.
This strong structure makes diamond extremely hard; it is transparent and has a high melting point.
Coal is an impure, amorphous form of carbon, whereas diamond is a pure, crystalline form of carbon.
items.finalAnswer: Allotropy is the existence of an element in different forms in the same physical state; coal is impure and amorphous, while diamond is pure and crystalline.

steps: A supercritical fluid is a substance at a temperature and pressure above its critical temperature and critical pressure.
In this state, the distinction between the liquid and gaseous states disappears.
Unlike an ordinary liquid, a supercritical fluid has no definite surface separating it from a gas.
It can diffuse like a gas while having a density closer to that of a liquid.
items.finalAnswer: A supercritical fluid exists above its critical temperature and pressure and has properties of both liquids and gases.
